text:
rita: Lumino Health submitted a billing dispute for INV-2026-1105. They say an onboarding worker left a staging flag enabled which led to retries and a usage spike. Asking for a one-time credit of $12,800 and Net45 for the next invoice. Can finance advise?
maya: Need the exact disputed amount vs invoice balance and any logs. What's the current balance?
jon: Current balance is $48,200. Customer uploaded CSV + infra logs showing retry loop from 2026-02-10..2026-02-17. Sales recommends one-time credit to reduce churn; renewal in 5 weeks.
maya: Finance position: approve a one-time customer_recovery credit of $12,800 (GL 4802_customer_recovery) and grant Net45 for INV-2026-1106 only, conditional on a countersigned one-paragraph amendment within 72 hours. Will tag memo and cap further retro credits without VP signoff. Approver: Maya (Finance Lead).
legal-bot: Draft amendment ready; includes non-precedent clause and explicitly limits Net45 to INV-2026-1106. No SLA or pricing changes.
billing-bot: Invoice INV-2026-1105 link: https://billing.redwood.internal/invoices/INV-2026-1105  balance $48,200. Collections: pause pending adjustment.
rita: I'll send the amendment and attach the logs. Will update when signed.
